aaa_note: True spray charts (hc_x/hc_y) with nobody-on / RISP / 2-strike splits are available for MLB hitters via Statcast. For AAA-only hitters, Statcast returns no rows and Prospect Savant only provides directional rates (pull / oppo) from their most recent AAA season — not count or base-state sprays.
synergy_note: Synergy spray uses landingLocationX/Y in feet (home→CF = +Y, toward RF = +X). Each chart plots the most recent 100 BIP (by gameDate; events/filter is newest-first). Multi-select: RISP/non-RISP and 2K/non-2K are independent. Points carry risp + two_strikes flags. MLB Statcast sprays retained under .mlb when available.
